events.label: WNBA • First Round
events.coverage: National ESPN2 window. No regional team telecast listed.
events.notes: Winner-take-all Game 3, series tied 1–1. Golden State won the opener 104–80; Dallas forced a decider 108–100 in overtime behind Arike Ogunbowale's playoff-record 45 points. The winner meets Las Vegas in the semifinals.
events.blackout: No territorial blackout is expected. TV-provider or ESPN streaming access is required; WNBA League Pass restrictions may apply to live national playoff games.
